module: Flowgraph node "Setup Parking System" (once_instant). Enables the parking spot placement system: gameplay_parking.setState(true), optional sitesData via setSites, then traffic:activateParkedCars(vehicleIds). On reset: deactivateParkedCars and setSites() with no argument.

onNodeReset.desc: Deactivates the parked cars and resets the parking system's sites.

workOnce.desc: Enables parking, applies the sites if provided and activates the parked cars for the id list.
